_comment: Shared gateway-coordinate test vectors. Identical copies live in the Segment avo-v2 tests and the monorepo RudderStack script tests; the two tables must match. A key missing from `input` means the value is not provided. `expected` lists the exact coordinate keys the event body carries: a key missing from `expected` MUST be absent from the body (not null, not ""). appVersion is always present; the token "<CHECKPOINT_DEFAULT>" stands for the platform's checkpoint default (Segment: appVersionPropertyName -> appVersion field -> 'unversioned'; RudderStack: context.app.version -> 'unversioned Rudderstack app').

coordinateCases.name: no coordinates: nothing added, checkpoint default version
cell 2: originHint without originAppVersion -> null version
cell 3: originAppVersion without originHint -> provided version
cell 4: neither -> checkpoint default (outputReference does not change the rule)
whitespace-only originHint counts as absent for the appVersion rule
whitespace-only originAppVersion with originHint -> null version

untypedInputCases._comment: Only where the platform can hand the code a non-string value (a RudderStack getter, a Segment mapping path resolving to a non-string, if the framework lets it through). Mirrors the sGTM toHintString: numbers and booleans are stringified, null/objects/arrays are absent.

cases.name: object and array values are omitted

propertyCollisionCase.name: event properties named like the coordinates stay ordinary properties

invariants: X-Avo-Client header value === body libPlatform, for every event body, and both are the platform constant
api-key and env headers are always sent
outputReference/originHint are top-level siblings of eventProperties, never inside it
coordinates never affect batching, dedup or sampling
